test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The last Sub-Section (k) on the education of children was added in 2002 as a part of the Fundamental Duties. The same Amendment also introduced _________ in the Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 21A.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​**During Indira Gandhi's Emergency in 1976,** The** Constitution (42nd Amendment) Act **added the **fundamental duties to Part IV-A of the Constitution.**
 
• **Ten of the eleven **essential duties listed in **Article 51(A) **were added with the** 42nd Amendment.**
 
• The** eleventh duty** was added in** 2002,** during the term of** Atal Bihari Vajpayee as Prime Minister.**
 
• These obligations are** not legally binding.**
 
• However, when making a decision, a** court **may take them into account.
 
• The** Constitution (86th Amendment) Act**, which was passed in** 2002,** introduced the **final subsection, (k).**
 
• This subsection deals with **children's education.**
 
• In the same revision,** Article 21A** was added to the Constitution.
 
• **Article 21A **states that “The State shall provide **free and compulsory education** to all children of the** age of six to fourteen years** in such manner as the State may, by law, determine.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 48A**:

 
 
• It is about the** protection and improvement of the environment** and the **safeguarding of forests and wildlife.**
 
 
 
• **Article 32A:**
 
 
• **The constitutional validity of State laws** is not to be considered in proceedings under **article 32**. 
 
 
 
• **Article 11A:**
 
 
• It is related to the **administration of justice; constitution and organisation of all courts**, **except the Supreme Court and the High Courts**.
